mainTopic: רבי יוסי's סימן for items moved between the inner and outer altars, and where the מזבח stood in the עזרה according to רבי יוסי, רבי יהודה and רבי יוסי הגלילי.
overview: רבי יוסי gives a סימן: anything moved between the inner altar and the outer altar uses the side of the outer altar nearest the היכל. The גמרא asks what this adds, since the תורה already says it about the שירים and the יום הכיפורים coals. It answers that the rule teaches about the בזיכי לבונה of the לחם הפנים and the daily coals for the קטורת, which are learned from those cases. Next the גמרא asks where רבי יוסי holds the מזבח stood, since he places the second מערכה four אמות from the southwest corner. It works through the numbers for each possible location and concludes that he must hold the whole מזבח is in the north. רב אדא בר אהבה says instead that the source follows רבי יהודה, who puts the מזבח in the middle of the עזרה. That works if the four אמות are counted after the base and the ledge, making six in all. רב שרביא offers another author, רבי יוסי הגלילי, whose ברייתא from the פסוקים about the כיור begins here and continues on the next amud.

steps.title: רבי יוסי's rule: use the side of the outer altar nearest the היכל
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוסי gives a two-part סימן. Items moving from the inner altar to the outer altar, or from the outer altar to the inner altar, always use the part of the outer altar closest to the היכל.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוסי says: Here is a rule of thumb. Anything taken from inside to be placed outside may be placed only at the spot nearest the inside. And anything taken from outside to be placed inside may be taken only from the spot nearest the inside.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוסי gives a simple memory rule for any item that moves between the two altars. It always uses the part of the outer altar that faces the היכל.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are two directions: inside to outside, and outside to inside. In both directions the answer is the same. You use the side of the מזבח החיצון closest to the היכל, which is the western side.

keyTerms.meaning: This is a sign, a rule of thumb to help remember
That which is taken
Inside, meaning the inner (golden) altar in the היכל
Outside, meaning the outer altar in the courtyard
At the place that is near

steps.confusionAlert: Both halves of the rule talk about the same spot on the outer altar, the side facing the היכל. The rule never describes a spot on the inner altar.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yosei says: This is the sign (rule of thumb):
Anything that is taken inside to be placed outside,

phrases.aramaic: אֵינוֹ נוֹתֵן אֶלָּא בְּסָמוּךְ שֶׁאֵין לִפְנִים;
phrases.english: he places it only at the nearby spot, with nothing further inside it;
phrases.notes: He means the part of the outer altar closest to the היכל, so no other part of the altar is nearer to the inside.

phrases.english: and anything that is taken outside to be placed inside,

phrases.aramaic: אֵינוֹ נִיטָּל אֶלָּא בְּסָמוּךְ שֶׁאֵין לִפְנִים.
phrases.english: is taken only from the nearby spot, with nothing further inside it.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: Items going from the inner altar to the outer altar, or from the outer altar to the inner altar, use the side of the outer altar closest to the היכל.

steps.title: The first half of the rule is already a פסוק
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what the first half of the rule refers to. If it means the שירים of the inner חטאות, a פסוק already says openly that they go to the base by the entrance of the אהל מועד.
steps.simpleTranslation: Anything taken inside to be placed outside: what is it? If you say the leftover blood, it is written openly about it: 'at the base of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting'!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the first half of רבי יוסי's rule. The only obvious example, the leftover blood, is already stated plainly in the תורה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After the inner חטאות are sprinkled inside, the leftover blood is poured on the יסוד of the outer altar. The פסוק itself says it goes to the side 'at the entrance of the אהל מועד'. So why would רבי יוסי need a rule to teach something the פסוק already says?

keyTerms.meaning: What is it? Which case is meant?
If you would say
Leftover blood that remains after the sprinklings
It is written explicitly
The base (bottom ledge) of the altar

phrases.english: Anything that is taken inside to be placed outside,
what is it?
If you say it is the leftover blood,
phrases.notes: This is the blood left over after the sprinklings inside for the inner חטאות.

phrases.english: it is written explicitly about them:
"At the base of the altar of the burnt offering,
which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting"!

steps.triggerLanguage: כָּל הַנִּיטָּל בִּפְנִים לִינָּתֵן בַּחוּץ מַאי נִיהוּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the first half of רבי יוסי's rule as unnecessary.
steps.kashyaTarget: The first half of רבי יוסי's סימן (inner altar to outer altar).
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The obvious case, the שירים, is already spelled out in a פסוק, so a rule teaching it adds nothing.

steps.title: The second half of the rule is also already a פסוק
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא adds that the second half of the rule seems unnecessary too. The coals for the קטורת of יום הכיפורים are already described in a פסוק.
steps.simpleTranslation: And furthermore: anything taken outside to be placed inside, what is it? If you say the coals of יום הכיפורים, it is written openly about them: 'And he shall take a pan full of fiery coals,' and so on!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes the challenge further. The obvious example for the second half of the rule, the יום הכיפורים coals, is also already stated in the תורה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: On יום הכיפורים the כהן גדול takes coals from the outer altar in a מחתה and brings them inside for the קטורת. The פסוק already tells us where on the altar to take them from. Now both halves of רבי יוסי's סימן look unnecessary, which sets up the need for an answer.

keyTerms.meaning: And furthermore, an additional difficulty
Coals
Day of Atonement, when the כהן גדול brings coals inside for the קטורת
Coal pan

steps.whatToRemember: Both halves of רבי יוסי's rule seem to repeat what the תורה already says openly. The גמרא will need to find what new case the rule is teaching.

phrases.aramaic: וְתוּ, כֹּל הַנִּיטָּל בַּחוּץ לִינָּתֵן בִּפְנִים –
phrases.english: And furthermore, anything that is taken outside to be placed inside,
what is it?
If you say it is the coals of Yom Kippur,
it is written explicitly about them:
"And he shall take a pan full of fiery coals," and so on!
phrases.notes: ויקרא טז:יב. The 'and so on' points to the rest of the פסוק, 'from on the altar before ה׳'.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְתוּ, כֹּל הַנִּיטָּל בַּחוּץ לִינָּתֵן בִּפְנִים מַאי נִיהוּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a second, parallel challenge, this time against the second half of the rule.
steps.kashyaTarget: The second half of רבי יוסי's סימן (outer altar to inner altar).
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The obvious case, the יום הכיפורים coals, is already described in a פסוק, so the rule seems to add nothing.

steps.title: The first half of the rule is about the frankincense bowls of the showbread
steps.stepSummary: The first half of רבי יוסי's rule is not about the שירים. It is about the two בזיכי לבונה of the לחם הפנים, and we learn their place from the שירים.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, 'anything taken from inside to be placed outside' means the two bowls of frankincense of the showbread, which we learn from the leftover blood.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge from Step 2. The first half of רבי יוסי's rule refers to something no פסוק spells out: the two frankincense bowls of the לחם הפנים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The challenge was that the שירים already have an open פסוק, so the rule would be pointless. The answer is that the rule teaches about the בזיכין, which also go from inside to the outer מזבח. Their place on the side near the היכל is learned from the שירים.

keyTerms.meaning: The two bowls of frankincense placed next to the showbread
The showbread kept on the שולחן inside the היכל
Which they learn (one case from another)
The leftover blood of the inner חטאות

phrases.english: Rather, anything that is taken inside
phrases.notes: The גמרא is going back to the first half of רבי יוסי's rule from Step 1 and reading it a new way.

phrases.english: to be placed outside —
the two bowls of frankincense
of the showbread,
which are learned from the leftover blood.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא כׇּל הַנִּיטָּל בִּפְנִים לִינָּתֵן בַּחוּץ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of Step 2 by moving the first half of the rule to a new case.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reinterpretation: the rule refers to a different case that has no explicit פסוק
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The first half of the rule seemed to be about the שירים, which already have a פסוק.
steps.terutzMaskana: It is about the בזיכין of the לחם הפנים, learned from the שירים.

steps.title: The second half of the rule is about the daily coals for the incense
steps.stepSummary: The second half of רבי יוסי's rule refers to the coals taken every day for the קטורת. We learn their place from the coals of יום הכיפורים.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'Anything taken from outside to be placed inside' means the coals of every single day, which we learn from the coals of יום הכיפורים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge from Step 3. The second half of the rule is about the everyday coals for the קטורת, not the יום הכיפורים coals.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק only speaks about the coals of יום הכיפורים. רבי יוסי's rule adds that the daily coals must also be taken from the side near the היכל, learned from יום הכיפורים.

keyTerms.meaning: Coals
Of each and every day
The Day of Atonement

steps.whatToRemember: Both halves of רבי יוסי's rule teach about cases the פסוקים do not spell out: the בזיכין and the daily coals. Each is learned from the case that does have a פסוק.

phrases.english: That which is taken outside to be placed inside —
the coals of each and every day,
which we learn from the coals
of יום הכיפורים.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the answer started in Step 4, now for the second half of the rule.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Reinterpretation: the rule refers to a different case learned by comparison
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The second half seemed to be about the יום הכיפורים coals, which already have a פסוק.
steps.terutzMaskana: It is about the daily coals, learned from the יום הכיפורים coals.

steps.title: If the whole altar is in the south, the wood pile should be 27 אמות north
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges רבי יוסי's placement of the second מערכה four אמות from the southwest corner. If the whole מזבח stands in the south of the courtyard, the pile would need to be 27 אמות north to face the entrance of the היכל.
steps.simpleTranslation: And what does he hold? If he holds that the whole altar stands in the south, he would need to bring it 27 אמות!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens a new challenge about another statement of רבי יוסי: he puts the second מערכה only four אמות north of the southwest corner. It asks what view of the מזבח's location would make that work.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The coals for the קטורת should come from the part of the מזבח facing the היכל. If the whole 32-אמה מזבח is in the southern half, only its northernmost 5 אמות face the היכל entrance. So the pile would have to be 27 אמות from the southwest corner, not four.

keyTerms.meaning: He holds (this view)
Stands in the south
To bring (to move it)
A pile of wood on the מזבח

steps.confusionAlert: This is a new topic, not part of the סימן just explained. The גמרא is now asking about רבי יוסי's other statement, where the second wood pile sits four אמות from the southwest corner.

phrases.english: And what does he hold?
phrases.notes: "He" is רבי יוסי. The question is about where he puts the second wood pile, four אמות from the southwest corner.

phrases.english: If he holds that the entire altar
stands in the south,
he would need to bring it twenty-seven!
phrases.notes: Twenty-seven אמות north of the corner. Only then does the pile face the entrance of the היכל.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמַאי קָסָבַר? אִי קָסָבַר כּוּלֵּיהּ מִזְבֵּחַ בְּדָרוֹם קָאֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves the סימן discussion and opens a new challenge on רבי יוסי's placement of the second מערכה.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוסי's statement that the second מערכה sits four אמות north of the southwest corner
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the whole מזבח is in the south, only its northern 5 אמות face the היכל. Facing the היכל would therefore require 27 אמות, not 4.

steps.title: Even counting the Entrance Hall, the wood pile should be 22 אמות north
steps.stepSummary: Even if רבי יוסי holds that the היכל and the אולם have the same holiness, so the pile only has to face the wider אולם, it would still need to be 22 אמות north, not four.
steps.simpleTranslation: And even if he holds that the holiness of the היכל and the אולם is one, he would need to bring it 22 אמות!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tries a second way to explain רבי יוסי and shows it still does not fit. The challenge stays strong.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The אולם is 10 אמות wider than the היכל, so 5 more אמות of the מזבח would face it, making 10 in all. That still leaves 22 אמות from the corner, far more than the four רבי יוסי said.

keyTerms.meaning: The holiness of the Sanctuary and the Entrance Hall
It is one (the same)
The Entrance Hall in front of the היכל

phrases.english: And even if he holds
that the holiness of the Sanctuary and the Entrance Hall is one,
he would need to bring it twenty-two!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי נָמֵי קָסָבַר קְדוּשַּׁת הֵיכָל וְאוּלָם חֲדָא הִיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the elimination begun in step 6 by showing that a second possible view also fails to give four אמות.
steps.kashyaTarget: The possibility that רבי יוסי holds the whole מזבח is in the south but treats the היכל and אולם as equally holy
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Even if the pile only has to face the wider אולם, the math gives 22 אמות, still not four.

steps.title: Even half north and half south needs eleven cubits
steps.stepSummary: If רבי יוסי held the מזבח was half in the north and half in the south, the מערכה would still need to be eleven אמות from the corner, not four.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if he holds that half of the מזבח is in the north and half in the south, he would still need to move it eleven אמות!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא keeps testing other possible pictures of where the מזבח stood. Now it tries a מזבח split evenly between north and south, and that still does not fit four אמות.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Steps 6 and 7 assumed the whole מזבח was in the south, which needed 27 or 22 אמות. Moving the מזבח to the middle cuts the distance, but eleven אמות is still far more than four.

keyTerms.meaning: half of it in the north and half in the south
eleven
to bring, here meaning to move it over

phrases.english: And if he holds that half of it is in the north
and half of it in the south,
he would need to move it eleven [אמות]!
phrases.notes: The מזבח is 32 אמות wide and the opening of the היכל is 10. If both are centered, the corner sticks out 11 past the opening.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי קָסָבַר חֶצְיוֹ בַּצָּפוֹן וְחֶצְיוֹ בַּדָּרוֹם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tries a new placement of the מזבח after the all-south placement failed in steps 6 and 7.
steps.kashyaTarget: The idea that רבי יוסי pictures the מזבח split evenly between north and south
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: With a centered מזבח, the corner is 11 אמות away from the line of the entrance, so four אמות would not face the opening.

steps.title: Even facing the wider אולם needs six cubits
steps.stepSummary: Even if the מזבח is centered and the מערכה only has to face the wider opening of the אולם, it would still need to be six אמות from the corner.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you say instead that he holds the holiness of the היכל and the אולם is one and the same, he would still need to move it six אמות!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tries the last way out for a centered מזבח: maybe facing the wider אולם is enough. Even that needs six אמות, not four.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The opening of the אולם is 20 אמות wide, twice as wide as the opening of the היכל. That shrinks the distance from eleven to six, but it still does not match four.

keyTerms.meaning: six
one and the same thing

phrases.english: And rather, he holds that the holiness of the היכל and the אולם
is one and the same?
He would still need to move it six!
phrases.notes: The opening of the אולם is 20 wide, so it reaches 10 on each side of the center. The corner is 16 from the center, so 16 minus 10 is 6.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאֶלָּא קָסָבַר קְדוּשַּׁת הֵיכָל וְאוּלָם חֲדָא מִילְּתָא הִיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Takes the אולם idea from step 7 and applies it to the centered מזבח of step 8.
steps.kashyaTarget: A centered מזבח combined with treating the היכל and אולם as equally holy
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Even the wider opening still leaves the corner six אמות outside it, so four אמות does not work.

steps.title: So רבי יוסי must hold the whole altar is in the north
steps.stepSummary: Since every other picture fails, רבי יוסי must hold that the entire מזבח stood in the northern half of the עזרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, isn't it because he holds that the whole מזבח stands in the north?
steps.whatsHappening: Every other option has been ruled out. Now the גמרא draws its conclusion: four אמות only works if the whole מזבח is in the north.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the southern edge of the מזבח sits on the center line of the עזרה, then only its southern five אמות are in front of the 10-אמה opening. A spot four אמות from the southwest corner falls inside those five, so it faces the היכל. This backs up the view that the whole מזבח is in the north.

keyTerms.meaning: rather, is it not that... (a way of drawing the only option left)
the entire מזבח stands in the north

steps.whyThisMatters: This is the payoff of the whole calculation from steps 6 to 10. The position of the מערכה shows where רבי יוסי held the מזבח stood.

phrases.english: Rather, is it not because he holds
that the whole מזבח stands in the north?

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא לָאו מִשּׁוּם דְּקָסָבַר כּוּלֵּיהּ מִזְבֵּחַ בְּצָפוֹן קָאֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws the conclusion after steps 6 to 9 knocked out every other placement.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי יוסי holds the whole מזבח stood in the northern half of the עזרה
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי יוסי's placement of the second מערכה four אמות from the southwest corner, together with the numbers from steps 6 to 9

steps.title: What the four cubits are made of
steps.stepSummary: The four אמות are the base, the ledge, the corners and a walkway for the כהנים. Going any farther would take the מערכה out of line with the entrance.
steps.simpleTranslation: And these four אמות are: one אמה for the base, one for the surrounding ledge, one for the place of the corners, and one for the place where the כהנים walk. If they moved it any farther in, it would no longer face the entrance.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why the number is exactly four. It also explains why the מערכה could not be placed any deeper in.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each of the four אמות is taken up by a part of the מזבח or by walking space, so the מערכה can start only after them. It cannot go farther, because after the fifth אמה you are past the edge of the opening of the היכל. That makes four the only spot that works.

keyTerms.meaning: the base of the מזבח
the ledge that runs around the מזבח
the corners (horns) of the מזבח
the walkway for the כהנים' feet
entrance or opening, here of the היכל

steps.whatToRemember: According to this reading, רבי יוסי holds the whole מזבח is in the north. The four אמות are base, ledge, corners and walkway, and they end just before the line of the היכל's opening runs out.

phrases.english: And these four אמות:
an amah for the base, and an amah for the surrounding ledge,
and an amah for the place of the corners,
and an amah for the place of the כהנים' feet;
for if they move it farther in,
it is no longer in front of the entrance.
phrases.notes: Only the southern five אמות of the מזבח line up with the opening, so going past them leaves the line of the היכל.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Fills in the details of the conclusion in step 10 by explaining the four אמות.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why exactly four אמות, and not more
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Four אמות are taken up by base, ledge, corners and walkway, and any farther would pass the edge of the opening.

steps.title: רב אדא says the source follows רבי יהודה
steps.stepSummary: רב אדא בר אהבה rejects the proof by saying the source with the four אמות follows רבי יהודה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אדא בר אהבה said: Whose view is this? It is רבי יהודה's.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אדא בר אהבה pushes back on the proof from steps 6 to 11. He says the source with the four אמות follows רבי יהודה, so it does not show how רבי יוסי pictured the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The proof only works if this source reflects רבי יוסי's picture of the מזבח. By connecting it to רבי יהודה, who has his own picture of the מזבח, רב אדא takes away the proof's base.

keyTerms.meaning: whose view is this?

steps.confusionAlert: רב אדא is not saying the four אמות are wrong. He is only saying the source follows רבי יהודה's picture of the מזבח, so it cannot prove what רבי יוסי held.

phrases.english: רב אדא בר אהבה said:
Whose view is this? It is רבי יהודה's.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב אַדָּא בַּר אַהֲבָה הָא מַנִּי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה הִיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the proof that was just completed in steps 10 and 11.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The proof that the whole מזבח is in the north, as drawn from the four אמות
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The source may follow רבי יהודה, who pictures the מזבח differently.

steps.title: רבי יהודה: the altar stood in the middle of the courtyard
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא quotes רבי יהודה: the 32-אמה מזבח stood in the middle of the עזרה, lined up with the היכל, with ten אמות facing the opening and eleven on each side.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it was taught: רבי יהודה says the מזבח was centered and stood in the middle of the עזרה. It was 32 אמות wide: ten אמות faced the entrance of the היכל, eleven on one side and eleven on the other. So the מזבח lined up exactly with the היכל.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to show what רבי יהודה held. According to him, the מזבח stood in the center of the עזרה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Ten plus eleven plus eleven adds up to the full 32 אמות of the מזבח. That matches the width of the היכל, so the two line up exactly. This gives רב אדא a picture of the מזבח that is different from the all-north picture.

keyTerms.meaning: centered
the courtyard of the בית המקדש
lined up exactly

phrases.english: As it was taught: רבי יהודה says:
The מזבח was centered and stood
in the middle of the courtyard;
and it was thirty-two אמות wide:

phrases.aramaic: עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת כְּנֶגֶד פִּתְחוֹ שֶׁל הֵיכָל,
phrases.english: ten אמות opposite the entrance of the היכל,
eleven אמות on this side,
and eleven אמות on that side;
so the מזבח lines up exactly opposite the היכל.

steps.triggerLanguage: דְּתַנְיָא רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר מִזְבֵּחַ מְמוּצָּע וְעוֹמֵד בְּאֶמְצַע הָעֲזָרָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings the ברייתא that shows the view of רבי יהודה which רב אדא relied on.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי יהודה holds the מזבח stood in the center of the עזרה

steps.title: The numbers do not fit רבי יהודה
steps.stepSummary: According to רבי יהודה, the מערכה would have to be eleven אמות from the corner, or at least six. It could not be four.
steps.simpleTranslation: In the end, according to רבי יהודה, the wood pile would have to be moved eleven אמות in. And even if he holds that the היכל and the אולם have the same holiness, it would still have to be six אמות. So how can the source say four?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רב אדא בר אהבה. The numbers in רבי יהודה's ברייתא do not give the four אמות that the source says.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה said the 32-אמה מזבח had eleven אמות on each side of the ten-אמה opening of the היכל. So to stand opposite the היכל, the מערכה must be eleven אמות from the corner. Even if lining up with the wider (twenty-אמה) opening of the אולם is good enough, that leaves six on each side, which is still more than four.

keyTerms.meaning: In the end, no matter what
Eleven
The holiness of the Sanctuary and of the Entrance Hall
One and the same thing
Six

phrases.english: In the end, according to רבי יהודה,
it would need to be brought in eleven [אמות];
phrases.notes: He means the wood pile has to move eleven אמות in from the corner to face the opening of the היכל.

phrases.english: and if he holds

phrases.aramaic: קְדוּשַּׁת הֵיכָל וְאוּלָם חֲדָא מִילְּתָא הִיא,
phrases.english: that the holiness of the היכל and the אולם is one and the same,
it would still need to be brought in six!
phrases.notes: The אולם opening is wider, so there are only six אמות on each side instead of eleven.

steps.triggerLanguage: סוֹף סוֹף, לְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה חַד סְרֵי בָּעֵי לְמֵיתֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the numbers in רבי יהודה's ברייתא (step 13) to attack רב אדא בר אהבה's claim (step 12).
steps.kashyaTarget: רב אדא בר אהבה's claim that the four-אמות source follows רבי יהודה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי יהודה's measurements call for eleven or six אמות from the corner, not four.

steps.title: The four אמות are on top of the base and the ledge
steps.stepSummary: The four אמות do not include the base or the ledge. Adding those two אמות gives six, which fits רבי יהודה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Do you think these four אמות include the one אמה of the base and the one אמה of the ledge? No. The four אמות are counted besides the base and the ledge.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge. The four אמות are measured only after the base and the ledge, so the true distance from the corner is six אמות.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The challenge assumed the four אמות were counted from the outer edge of the מזבח. Once you add the base (one אמה) and the ledge (one אמה), the total is six. That exactly matches the six אמות needed to face the opening of the אולם.

keyTerms.meaning: Do you really think...? (introduces a mistaken assumption)
The base at the bottom of the מזבח
The ledge that goes around the מזבח
Besides, not counting

steps.confusionAlert: Step 11 said the four אמות included the base and the ledge. Here the גמרא reads them the other way, as not including them. That is exactly what makes the numbers work.

phrases.english: Do you think these four אמות
include the one אמה of the base and the one אמה of the ledge?!

phrases.aramaic: אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת בַּר מֵאַמָּה יְסוֹד וְאַמָּה סוֹבֵב.
phrases.english: The four אמות are besides the one אמה of the base and the one אמה of the ledge.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 14 by counting the four אמות differently.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Changes how the measurement is counted
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The four אמות are counted from the outer edge, so they include the base and the ledge.
steps.terutzMaskana: The four אמות come after the base and the ledge, so the total is six. That fits רבי יהודה.

steps.title: Why not say it follows רבי יוסי with the מזבח in the middle?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why רב אדא בר אהבה did not explain the source as רבי יוסי, with the מזבח in the center.
steps.simpleTranslation: But let him explain the source as following רבי יוסי, and say that the מזבח was in the middle.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why רב אדא בר אהבה needed רבי יהודה at all. The same six-אמות explanation could also work for רבי יוסי if he placed the מזבח in the middle.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once the six-אמות count works with a centered מזבח, any opinion that centers the מזבח would fit. So why switch from רבי יוסי, whose name was already being discussed, to רבי יהודה?

keyTerms.meaning: Let him explain it as (literally: let him set it up as)
In the middle, centered

phrases.english: But let him explain it as following רבי יוסי,
with the מזבח in the middle!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Now that the six-אמות count works, the גמרא asks why רבי יהודה was chosen over רבי יוסי.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב אדא בר אהבה's choice of רבי יהודה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A centered מזבח could also be assigned to רבי יוסי, so there was no need to move to a different תנא.

steps.title: Only רבי יהודה clearly says the מזבח was in the middle
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה is chosen because he is clearly on record placing the מזבח in the center. רבי יוסי is not.
steps.simpleTranslation: Because with רבי יהודה, we heard him say clearly that the מזבח was in the middle.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that רב אדא בר אהבה picked רבי יהודה because the ברייתא has him saying outright that the מזבח was centered.
steps.deeperAnalysis: It is safer to assign a source to a תנא whose view is stated openly than to guess at someone else's. With רבי יוסי, we would only be assuming he held the מזבח was centered.

keyTerms.meaning: We heard him say it (we have it from him)
Clearly, openly

phrases.english: Because רבי יהודה, we heard him say
clearly that it was in the middle.
phrases.notes: This points back to the ברייתא in step 13, where רבי יהודה says the מזבח stood in the middle of the עזרה.

steps.triggerLanguage: מִשּׁוּם דְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה שְׁמַעְנָא לֵיהּ מְמוּצָּע בְּהֶדְיָא
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי יוסי could just as well be the author, with a centered מזבח.
steps.terutzMaskana: Only רבי יהודה is clearly on record placing the מזבח in the middle, so he is the better choice.
steps.whatToRemember: According to רב אדא בר אהבה, the four-אמות source follows רבי יהודה. The מזבח was centered, and the four אמות come after the base and the ledge, making six in total.

steps.title: רב שרביא: the source follows רבי יוסי הגלילי
steps.stepSummary: רב שרביא gives a different answer. The source follows רבי יוסי הגלילי, who puts the whole מזבח in the north.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רב שרביא said: Whose opinion is this source? It is רבי יוסי הגלילי.
steps.whatsHappening: A new אמורא offers a different answer about whose view the four-אמות source follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Instead of centering the מזבח the way רבי יהודה does, רב שרביא assigns the source to רבי יוסי הגלילי. His ברייתא, which begins in the next step and continues on the next amud, puts the whole מזבח in the northern half of the עזרה, so the four אמות can fit without any extra counting.

keyTerms.meaning: Whose opinion is this?

steps.confusionAlert: רבי יוסי הגלילי is not the same person as the רבי יוסי discussed earlier. They are two different תנאים.

phrases.english: And רב שרביא said:
Whose opinion is this?
It is רבי יוסי הגלילי.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַב שֵׁרֵבְיָא אָמַר: הָא מַנִּי – רַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי הִיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a different author for the source than רב אדא בר אהבה's רבי יהודה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The four-אמות source follows רבי יוסי הגלילי.

steps.title: The ברייתא of רבי יוסי הגלילי begins with a פסוק about the כיור
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא starts quoting רבי יוסי הגלילי's ברייתא, which learns from the פסוק placing the כיור between the אהל מועד and the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it was taught in a ברייתא: רבי יוסי הגלילי says, since it says: "And you shall place the כיור between the אהל מועד" and so on, "and..."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings support for רב שרביא by beginning to quote רבי יוסי הגלילי's ברייתא. It continues past this point.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוסי הגלילי builds his view from פסוקים about where the כיור and the מזבח stood. Only the first פסוק and the start of the second appear here, so his full reasoning comes in the next lines.

keyTerms.meaning: Since it says (introduces a proof from a פסוק)
The basin the כהנים washed from
The Tent of Meeting
And so on (the rest of the פסוק)

phrases.english: As it was taught in a ברייתא:
רבי יוסי הגלילי says,
since it says:

phrases.aramaic: ״וְנָתַתָּ אֶת הַכִּיּוֹר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד״ וְגוֹמֵר,
phrases.english: "And you shall place the basin between the Tent of Meeting" and so on,
phrases.notes: שמות 40:7. The פסוק ends "and the מזבח."
This is the start of a second פסוק. The quote continues in the next lines of the גמרא.

steps.triggerLanguage: דְּתַנְיָא: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי אוֹמֵר, מִתּוֹךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings the ברייתא that backs up רב שרביא's statement.
steps.raayaObject: רב שרביא's claim that רבי יוסי הגלילי puts the מזבח where the four-אמות source needs it
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא of רבי יוסי הגלילי that learns from the פסוקים in שמות 40 about the כיור and the מזבח
